comparison.objective: Unlock, extend, relock, and load-test a twist-lock pole; candidate breaks and collects four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counter-torque on coaxial tubes, controlled extension, and friction locking versus mandrel alignment, hammer impact, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Pole at its length mark and shortening under 2 mm during a 50 N push; no fracture, shell protection, or loose-fragment containment criterion.
comparison.reason: Its tested ability is friction-lock adjustment under axial proof load, meaningfully different from controlled notch fracture and debris recovery.
